_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Zu zara Jokalari {player_id} Hiru Jokalariko Tic Tac Toean.
Zure sinboloa '{symbol}' da.
Zure sinboloa 5x5 taulan jarrita, lau lerroz osatzen duzu.
Lerroak horizontala, bertikala edo diagonalak izan daitezke.
Bidali zure mugimendua '[4]' formatuan cell 4 markatzeko.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mugimenduaren formatu ezegokia. Erabili "[cell]" non zelula 0-{max_cell} den.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Zelula baliogabea: {cell}. 0 eta {max_cell} artean egon behar du.

game_action.placed: {player_id} jokalariak bere ikurra ({symbol}) jartzen du ({row}, {col}) eremuan.
